name: sk-chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
description: A growing input bar whose trailing button changes job rather than multiplying: dictate when empty, send when there is a draft, stop while the model is answering. The field grows to a line limit then scrolls internally, so the send button can never be pushed off screen.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKChatComposer(text: $draft, isStreaming: generating,
               onSend: send, onStop: cancel)
